name: @askviraj/claude-status
description: A fast powerline status line for Claude Code
author: Viraj Patel
//: Apple Silicon macOS only. `os` AND `cpu` together express the supported set exactly — with one target there is no cross product to leak — so npm refuses the install on an Intel Mac, on Linux and on Windows with EBADPLATFORM rather than failing at run time. The installer's own unsupported-platform message is the second line of defence, for an install forced past npm. The BINARY is not in this package: it is a GitHub release asset that `--install` downloads and verifies against bin/checksums.json, which `mise run build:installer` generates from the target table in .config/mise/tasks/_scripts/_rust. Adding a platform means that table, both fields here, and a build AND test matrix entry in .github/workflows/release.yml.
